title: Pukka Juice Cherry Blaze Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: Cherry Blaze is a deliciously flavoursome, complex blend from Pukka that takes sweet, succulent cherries, swirls them into zesty, refreshing lemonade and adds a touch of Pukka’s celebrated Blaze flavour – an irresistible combination of blueberries and raspberries with a blast of menthol. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
